description: llama.cpp b10835 fixes a divergent barrier in the CUDA f16 flash attention kernel. What broke, what it risked, and the update you make tonight. (Narration is AI-generated.)

narration_full: llama.cpp fixed three thousand two hundred thirty-two errors to zero. Your card's fast mode is flash attention, a fused math path that skips a giant intermediate write. It's been broken since February. The program doing that math skipped a barrier, a checkpoint where one chunk of your card waits for another. Chunks could read unfinished work, risking wrong answers. The catch is the price. Prompt speed moved point one five percent, inside measurement noise. Your card was speeding. Now it speeds legally. So tonight, pull the newest llama.cpp build and keep flash attention on. Same speed, no broken rules.
